nodes.label: Chaos Engineering Adoption Challenges
nodes.rationale: Business impact, scoping, unpredictable outcomes, resource limits, complexity, skills, result interpretation, cultural readiness, tool selection.

nodes.label: Chaos Mesh
nodes.rationale: Open-source platform injecting failures into distributed (Kubernetes) systems.

nodes.label: ChaosTwin
nodes.rationale: Applies a digital twin approach to chaos engineering, modelling workload, network and service layers to mitigate unforeseen events.

nodes.label: LLM-driven Chaos Engineering Automation
nodes.rationale: LLMs automate lifecycle from hypothesis creation to orchestration and remediation; chaos on multi-agent LLM systems exposes hallucinations and inter-agent failures.

nodes.label: Microservice Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decentralized, independently deployed services increase failure modes, motivating chaos experiments.

nodes.label: Digital Model
nodes.rationale: No automatic data exchange between physical and digital objects.

nodes.label: Digital Shadow
nodes.rationale: One-way automatic flow physical -> digital only.

nodes.label: Digital Twin
nodes.rationale: Physical and digital objects fully integrated with automatic data flow in both directions; distinguishes from model and shadow.

nodes.label: Federated Learning
nodes.rationale: Keeps user data local to address privacy in DT analytics.

nodes.label: Caddy Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: handle_path strips /api to mirror Vite dev proxy; flush_interval -1 disables buffering so SSE is live; encode only in static block so compression never touches event stream

nodes.label: Dry-Run Mode
nodes.rationale: Evaluate plans without committing resources for what-if analysis

nodes.label: React+Vite Web Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Supersedes legacy Flask dashboard; proxies /api so no CORS setup is needed

nodes.label: useEventStream Hook
nodes.rationale: Events coalesced over 120 ms window because chaos scenarios can emit hundreds per second; polling only as safety net (30s connected, 2s dropped)

nodes.label: Running the Fabric Digital Twin Simulator

nodes.label: Single Gunicorn Worker with 24 Threads
nodes.rationale: DTState lives in process memory; multiple workers would serve divergent twins, so concurrency comes from threads

nodes.label: Adaptive Parameter Adjustment (_adaptive_mode_cfg)
nodes.rationale: When fabric reliability <85% or link loss spikes, inflate penalty weights for risk-averse planning

nodes.label: Resilient Placement Strategy
nodes.rationale: Disjoint cross-federation standbys guard against correlated regional failures; pre-warmed reservations secure capacity ahead of failures

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events /stream Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Traffic is one-directional; SSE needs no extra dependency, Werkzeug cannot serve WebSocket properly, EventSource reconnects natively

nodes.label: Vite /api Proxy
nodes.rationale: Keeps browser same-origin so dt/api.py needs no CORS configuration
